## 1. Show the idea

Drop in a screenshot, texture sheet, sketch, or reference link.
Say which art is yours; link the source of anything adapted or reused.

## 2. What would you build with it?

One or two sentences. What does this offer alongside the closest
existing Chisel or vanilla blocks? A visual comparison is welcome.

## 3. Where does it fit?

Core Chisel / compatibility with [mod] / unsure.
Unsure is fine; decide together at content review.

## 4. What is the first useful set?

List or picture the proposed variants. Mark optional extras for later.
Flag intended special visuals, such as connected edges or animation.

## Progress — update together

- [ ] Sample ready for content review
- [ ] Scope and placement agreed by Cricket
- [ ] Agreed set implemented; PR / Commit linked
- [ ] In-game review complete
- [ ] Release checks complete; Cricket marks ready

Maintainer notes: decision and agreed scope / developer / PR / blockers.
